title: Add RAG templates, agent/tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Maya Patel
description: Context: Multiple customers and internal teams have asked for canonical quickstarts and reference templates for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agent/tool-calling usage. This PR adds curated RAG templates, language-idiomatic agent/tool-calling examples (Python + TypeScript), docs site quickstarts, and small updates to the examples repo to make onboarding smoother. Motivation: reduce friction for engineers to adopt RAG patterns with Redwood (prefix/KV cache considerations, chunking recommendations, and scoring), and provide approved examples for tool-calling agents that demonstrate structured output and fallback behavior. What this PR includes: - RAG templates: redwood-examples/rag/templates/basic_rag.md (design + config + prompt templates), rag/advanced_rerank.md (reranking + embeddings usage), rag/sample_prompts/*.json (canonical prompt sets). - Agent/tool-calling examples: redwood-examples/agents/tool-calling/python_example.py (requests + tool registry + structured outputs), redwood-examples/agents/tool-calling/ts_example.ts (TypeScript SDK usage with streaming and function-like tool callbacks). - Quickstarts and docs: redwood-docs/docs/quickstarts/rag-quickstart.md, redwood-docs/docs/quickstarts/agents-quickstart.md; navigation updates to add quickstarts to the main Getting Started sidebar. - Tests and CI: lightweight smoke tests added under redwood-examples/tests/test_rag_templates.py and CI job to lint/verify quickstart snippets. - Misc: updated code comments, link fixes, and small doc copy edits. Checklist: - [x] Add canonical RAG templates and example prompts - [x] Add Python + TS agent/tool-calling examples with README notes - [x] Wire quickstarts into docs sidebar and verify build locally - [x] Add smoke tests for example snippets - [x] Address reviewer feedback and fix link typos Back-compat and safety: All examples use supported client APIs and reference pinned SDK versions in examples/requirements.txt and package.json. No runtime changes or public API surface changes. Deployment notes: docs site build updated; quickstarts included in the next docs release. Testing: Ran local mkdocs build, unit smoke tests, and CI doc lint. CI status at merge: green. See review conversation below for details on minor follow-ups (typo fixes and a short note about chunk overlap recommendation).
commits: Add initial RAG templates and sample prompts
Add Python & TypeScript agent/tool-calling examples with README
Add smoke tests for examples and CI job
Fix doc typos and update links after review
